steps.content: The sea breeze has halted, and the waves have fallen silent. The girl's laughter and cries fade away, replaced by pain tightening around your brain and stomach, as well as a familiar rancid odor.

The sun is shining into Doyle's filthy home. You're nestled on the messy sofa, with tattered socks hanging above your head on the sofa's back. As you dodge them to get up, a note floats down before you.

steps.speaker: Note
steps.content: Rest properly and don't ******* go wandering around again before I come back. —Doyle

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You can rest a bit more, Chief. Hecate already updated the Bureau about the situation.

The digital clock reads: <color=#fb9259>N.F. 112.10.03</color>, 07:16. A little more than a day has passed. You can't tell if that's a long or short time. The endless summer in the dream has blurred your perception of time.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What happened at the scene of the attack?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: At the same time as you were attacked, Hecate arrived on the scene and saved you. She had a brief confrontation with the suspicious woman who attacked you, and confirmed that she was the fourth Sinner at the scene of the crisis. The Sinner's abilities are unknown.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That fourth Sinner took her away. The arrest team went to work right away, but not long ago, S-666's power anomalies suddenly stopped. The contamination from her Sleepwalking symptoms disappeared at the same time, and we lost track of her.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: In the worst case scenario, your attacker forcibly ended S-666's Sleepwalking state by killing her, to shake off our pursuit.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I think... Roulecca woke up from her dream, that's all.

steps.content: You tell Nightingale about the "dream" you experienced. You recount the imprisonment of Sleepwalkers' consciousness, the source of the contamination, the deepening of the Sleepwalking state and its termination method, and most importantly...
The root cause of everything, <color=#fb9259>Ambrosia</color>.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ... All this time, Sleepwalkers' M-values remained within the safe range, so the FAC did not officially classify this mutation as a form of Mania.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But if "Ambrosia" can alter human consciousness so deeply and with such precision that it can even change the reality... Then it can already be classified as a <color=#fb9259>new strain of Mania</color>. A strain that is even stealthier.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I'll immediately notify the FAC for a harm and mitigation analysis. The City Council keeps a tight grip over Eastside, but with enough bargaining chips, the FAC can also gain greater authority to act.
Roulecca's sobs still echo in your ears. How many more people will be ensnared by the supplier's Ambrosia as you wait? How many more hearts will break because of it...?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Ambrosia has already caused serious damage to your mind. Please consider your own safety first.
Serious damage? No. In fact, maybe it's just the opposite...
...The inspector is investigating the source of Ambrosia. Hella went with him.
Hecate emerges from the kitchen and hands you a warm drink.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Before he went out, he taught me how to make this hangover drink. It's his wife's secret recipe. It'll make you feel better. You'll focus on the investigation better after drinking it and regaining your energy.
You're surprised to discover that he has a kind side, and gulp down the drink down gratefully.
Then, you retch from the inexplicable smell, sapping the last bit of energy out of you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: He says the door is locked, and that forcibly breaking it would cause a lot of trouble. He wants you to patiently wait for him to return.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If you're bored, there are lots of incident reports here. He says you can read whatever you like.
You have no choice but to surrender to their efforts.
